name: Antoine LeRouge
source:
The mysterious owner of Café Rouge. He hires the protagonist as a waitress upon their first meeting, even though she's unqualified for the job.

He holds a lot of secrets, and has a dark past. Most of the time he is on "business trips" and leaves his best friend Demian, head manager, to run the café.
